title: refactor(types): retire UIEventHandler and EventableSchema (objectui#6497)
body:
Fixes #6497
Clause-②: yes

## What this does

Retires two published types from `@object-ui/types` under ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove, as ruled on the card (comment 5812987361, director seat, maintainer 「同意」: remove, the re-priced option 2, startup-stage rule, no window).

- `UIEventHandler` and `EventableSchema` are deleted from `packages/types/src/api-types.ts`. A tombstone comment stands where they were: the ruling, what went, and the supported form.
- Their two re-export lines leave the root barrel `packages/types/src/index.ts` (the `./api-types.js` clause), with a short tombstone comment in their place. The `./form.js` clause (objectui#10313) is not touched.
- `APISchema` drops its `EventableSchema` arm and is now `DataFetchableSchema | ExpressionNodeSchema`.
- The `dialog.actions[].handler` member goes with `UIEventHandler`. It was a recursive member inside that interface's own declaration, not a separate consumer.
- The changeset is `minor` with the BREAKING banner and the ADR-0049 disposition line. It names the removal, the `APISchema` arm drop and the `actions[].handler` member, and gives `ActionDef` (`@object-ui/core`) as the supported form. No replacement type, dialect or alias is added.
- A pin, `packages/types/src/__tests__/eventable-schema-retired-6497.test.ts`, follows the objectui#8800 retired-export pattern (`ai-insights-retired-8800.test.ts`). It has four `@ts-expect-error` legs (module and barrel, for each name), source-text legs for the declaration, the `APISchema` union body and the barrel entries, and a tree-wide `git grep` for both names. Every leg has a lit control on the same instrument.

## First act on claim: the "second gate" (comment 5534973498) no longer holds

Verbatim from 5534973498 section 3: "`Clause-②: yes` — the published-surface limb, unambiguously. That routes it through `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (`claude-fable-5`) before it can land. ⚠️ **That tier is quota-exhausted right now** … So re-queueing this card would put a second item into a queue for work that provably cannot land today." The same comment gives its own release condition: "The moment that tier answers, this card is dispatch-ready with no further measurement."

Measured 2026-09-24, before any edit:

- **The tier answers today.** I read this repository's issue comments updated since 2026-09-23T12:00Z over REST (3 pages of 100, newest first). 30 of them carry `Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. The newest is at 17:45:46Z on objectui#9526, and `VERDICT: PASS` records sit on objectui#10314, objectui#10311 and objectui#10297, among others. Control on the same read: 48 `os-dev-report` comments. objectstack's comments in the same window carry 31 such records.
- The requirement half was already lifted for this card on 2026-09-10 (comment 5612085596). ⚠️ The current objectstack rule text (`landing-operations.md`, the 条款② enqueue gate, on objectstack `origin/main` 61609edf) again requires an at-tier clause-② review PASS on the declared limb before enqueue. That is a landing step for the dispatch seat, not an implementation gate. The tier that serves it answers today, so "cannot land today" is false.

## Census (all tracked files, base 1dbb9933)

`git grep -n -E 'UIEventHandler|EventableSchema' HEAD -- .` returns 16 hits: 14 in `packages/types/src/api-types.ts` and the 2 re-export lines in `packages/types/src/index.ts`. There are zero hits in `.md`/`.mdx`, `content/docs/**`, `examples/**`, `apps/**`, the published `skills/**` or any CHANGELOG. Lit controls on the same instrument: `BaseSchema|action:button` hits 8 files under `skills/`, 14 under `examples/`, 28 under `content/docs/` and 3 under `apps/`. Re-run on `origin/main` 7a564e00, five commits later: still zero outside the two files.

- **`actions[].handler`.** Reads of a `.handler` member in non-test `packages/*/src` and `apps/*/src` return 2 hits, and neither is a dialog action: `JobPreview.tsx` reads a job's `handler` string, and `useKeyboardShortcuts.ts` calls `shortcut.handler`. Nothing reads the member, so it goes with the type.
- **`APISchema` readers.** The only hits are its declaration and the barrel re-export, so no package imports it and dropping the arm breaks nothing. This also means no downstream package type-check is owed for the union change.

## Verification (head `c5118813`)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` runs `tsc --noEmit`, `tsconfig.examples.json` and `tsconfig.test.json`: exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` includes the new pin (1 hit).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types build`: exit 0, "dist completeness: 1 package(s) complete (130 emitted files verified)". `dist/index.d.ts` has 0 hits for either name. `dist/api-types.d.ts` has 0 declaration or export hits; its 5 hits are all inside the tombstone comment, the same way `dist/ai.d.ts` carries the objectui#8800 tombstone. Lit control: `DataFetchableSchema` hits 1 and 2 respectively, and the dist has `export type APISchema = DataFetchableSchema | ExpressionNodeSchema;`.
- The dependency closure `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/types^...' build` answers `ERR_PNPM_RECURSIVE_RUN_NO_SCRIPT`: the closure is empty.
- Running `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/types/` from the repo root gives `Test Files 215 passed (215)` and `Tests 4929 passed (4929)`. The new pin alone passes 6/6.
- Root repo-state tests: the six `.changeset` script suites (`check-changeset-no-major`, `-presence`, `-claims`, `check-pending-changeset-literals`, `changeset-polarity-census`, `body-dialect-census`) pass 279 tests, and `one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts` passes 11.
- `eslint . --format json` over `packages/types` lints 286 files with 0 errors. The new pin and `index.ts` have 0 warnings; the 12 `no-explicit-any` warnings in `api-types.ts` belong to the surviving declarations.
- These gates exit 0: `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots`, `type-check:coverage`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:self-import`, `check:handler-key-reads` and `check:unreferenced-sources`.
- `check:changeset-claims` is report-only. It flags `.changeset/6051-gantt-flat-config-declared-keys.md` for naming `index.ts`. I re-read it: `GanttConfig` is still exported by name, so the paragraph stays true.
- `check:readme-exports` is **NOT MEASURED**. It exits 1 ("the population COLLAPSED"), and `--list` exits 2 (PRECONDITION NOT MET) because every other package's `dist` is unbuilt, and a full workspace build is CI's job. Partial reading: the 22 `@object-ui/types` README self-import rows, for the only package whose exports changed, all read `real` against the rebuilt dist. None of them names either retired symbol.

## Ablation (fix committed first as `c5118813`)

I used `../objectstack/scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode, which restores automatically, plus a shell `trap` on absolute paths. No build step was involved. The pin reads the `../api-types.ts` and `../index.ts` source, and `tsc` reads `import('../index')` from source. Nothing goes through the package `exports` to `dist`.

- **A, as ordered: restore the two re-export lines.**
  - The first attempt was refused by the tool: the anchor `  DataFetchConfig,` was contained in the replacement, so the anchor count stayed at 1. Nothing was measured, and the file was restored to its HEAD blob.
  - The re-run used the anchor "`  APIConfig,` + newline + `  // `". The anchor count went 1 to 0, the replacement count 0 to 1, and the blob changed from `9544142e` to `e175cd64`. On disk, the barrel then had one `UIEventHandler,` entry and one `EventableSchema,` entry.
  - The pin went red: 1 failed, 5 passed. The failing leg is "the published BARREL no longer re-exports either symbol" (expected true to be false). `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` reported TS2578 (unused `@ts-expect-error`) at both barrel directives, plus TS2305 twice in `index.ts`.
  - Restored: blob == HEAD (`9544142e`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **B, extra: the whole retirement undone.** Both files were checked out at the base `1dbb9933`, and their blob hashes matched the base blobs.
  - The pin went red: 3 failed, 3 passed. The declaration, `APISchema`-arm and barrel legs failed, and `tsc` reported TS2578 at all four `@ts-expect-error` directives.
  - The tree-scan legs stay green by design, because the two edited files are excluded from the scan.
  - Restored: both blobs == HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Acceptance notes

- The dispatch pointed at an "ADR-0049 retirement" section in AGENTS.md. No such section exists on `main`, so I followed the objectui#8800 retired-export pin instead.
- The rest of `api-types.ts` has the same island shape, measured by census only. `HTTPMethod`, `APIRequest`, `APIConfig`, `DataFetchConfig`, `DataFetchableSchema`, `ExpressionNodeSchema` and `APISchema` have 0 tracked-file hits outside the module and the barrel. `ExpressionContext`'s 8 outside hits are `@object-ui/core`'s own `ExpressionContext`, a different symbol with the same name. I did not measure this at runtime (per AGENTS.md, a source-grep zero does not answer "no renderer reads this key"), so it is not filed. Carrier: none.
- This branch is not merged with `main`. `main` moved five commits (to `7a564e00`) that touch other `packages/types` tests and changesets, but not `api-types.ts` or `index.ts`. The merge queue rebuilds on `main`. objectui#10315 is already in this branch's base.
